title: spark-membrane: a fail-closed console that orchestrates pinned OES repositories without merging them
description:
spark-membrane is an offline, standard-library Python console that runs the existing Spark AI NLP OES repositories side by side without merging them. Upstream code is pinned by commit SHA in PINS.json; small labelled reference re-implementations are tested against outputs of the pinned upstream code.

Read first. On the locked NASA SMAP/MSL protocol, OES32 did not meet its pre-stated success criterion (oes-resilience v0.5.0). On the oes-telemetry-bench synthetic held-out set, max-abs matched OES32 (6/7) with fewer false alarms (11.54/h vs 23.08/h). The multi-quantum-oes stress evaluation was negative. oes32-hls synthesis and the qldpc_decoder_cpp kernel are UNRUN.

What it does. A T=0 audit accepts a native 32-channel frame only if the protocol hash, the normative residual, the oes32_engine Profile A sidecar and the weighted score all pass; max-abs, EWMA and CUSUM are advisory. The two OES-32 formulas are never blended. A seeded, protocol-capped one-index explorer (new code, inspired by an external dual-engine idea) reports REPAIRED_IN_SIM or LATCH_HELD with evidence class SYNTHETIC. Runs are hash-chained (measurement-trail format) and rendered as an evidence passport.

Limits. Everything is SYNTHETIC classical simulation. Not a medical device, not control software, not sensor fusion; no field-performance or superiority claims; it makes no quantum, QEC, consciousness, medical or gravity claims. Do not mint a GitHub release until the Zenodo webhook is enabled.
